quotes.text: Thy powers, to find out paths to ruin, and let Out the floods of sorrow to o’erwhelm mankind, How feeble is thy sceptre 1 — how uncertain man's- Decisions drawn from thy still remaining light ! Thy beams ere long must sink in night, and Chaos reign again, hut for the power and love Of Him who gave thee; and, by revelation from His own perfected reason, shall he lead thy steps,. Till thou regain…
Thy slanderous longue with lying mischief run, Thou lovest words that blast, devour, and burn; O that deceitful, blasting, cursed tongue! — ■
